songs.title: Don't Stop Believin'
songs.summary: 116 bars of tutorial-based piano accompaniment, including the walking bass, verses, Strangers section and chorus.
songs.materialDescription: Start with the eight-bar intro. Choose a section, practise each hand, or step through the keys without audio. Repeated riffs use consistent voicings for practice.
songs.notationAlt: Tutorial-based piano accompaniment in E major, both hands.

songs.title: Für Elise
songs.summary: The complete piece in its original 3/8, with both hands, slower playback, and shorter practice passages.
songs.materialDescription: Start with the opening, or select the whole piece. Piano view follows both hands through the performance, including repeats.
songs.notationAlt: Complete public-domain score of Für Elise in 3/8, both hands.

songs.title: Amazing Grace
songs.summary: A complete 16-bar tune in C, with a one-beat pickup and a simple left-hand bass part.
songs.materialTitle: Melody and bass · score and practice player
songs.materialDescription: Beginner arrangement of NEW BRITAIN. One complete verse of the tune, in 3/4.
songs.notationAlt: Amazing Grace in C major, melody and single-note bass.

songs.title: Lord of the Dance · Simple Gifts
songs.summary: The complete 16-bar Simple Gifts tune behind Lord of the Dance, arranged in C with a simple bass part.
songs.materialTitle: Melody and bass · score and practice player
songs.materialDescription: Original beginner arrangement of the traditional Simple Gifts tune used for Lord of the Dance. Includes both sections of the tune; no lyrics.
songs.notationAlt: Lord of the Dance · Simple Gifts in C major, melody and single-note bass.
